versions.changelog:
Initial release: structured, guided incident response

- Guides users through all phases: detection, triage, containment, resolution, and post-mortem
- Automatically classifies incident severity (P1-P4) and generates tailored checklists
- Creates real-time incident timelines and post-mortem templates
- Supports common incident types: outages, security events, data breaches, vendor failures, and performance issues
- Integrates with popular monitoring tools and manual incident inputs
